Name: VirtualMetric DataStream CCF
Author: VirtualMetric
Description: The [VirtualMetric DataStream](https://docs.virtualmetric.com/) Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push solution lets the VirtualMetric DataStream agent push security and ASIM-normalized telemetry directly to Microsoft Sentinel. Two tiles let you selectively enable Standard streams (CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, Event, Syslog, WindowsEvent) or ASIM-normalized streams (Audit, Authentication, Dhcp, Dns, File, NetworkSession, Process, Registry, UserManagement, WebSession). Both tiles share a single Data Collection Endpoint per workspace. Authentication, DCR provisioning, Entra app, and required role assignments are automated when each tile's Deploy button is clicked.
